title: D4-native matched O0/O2/BP finite-size curve pilot
question: Under X-only physical noise (p_X varied, p_Z=0), do O0, published O2, and D4-likelihood BP produce different matched flux-recovery finite-size curves near the paper threshold window?

scope.score: first-stage Boolean-union flux logical failure under X-only noise, conditional on nonterminal physical winding; charge recovery is excluded

acceptance: all policies consume identical physical errors and D4 public observations
no threshold promotion from this pilot
claim_boundary: Bounded D4-native X-only finite-size pilot only. It can choose a subsequent flux-threshold-window allocation but cannot establish an asymptotic threshold, a full X/Z D4 LER, charge-recovery performance, or a numerical comparison to Lab 003.
